svg.text: Example 4 · an unsolved problem, as an image, as music, read backwards
Collatz orbits of 1…64 → structure → image description → score → reversed → back → compare_structures says what survived
x = n · y = stopping time · size = log peak · colour = group
pitch ← y · duration ← weight · velocity ← x
reversed: identical = False, order reversed = True
x ↦ N + 1 − x : an encoding artefact, not an invariant
the round trip is a real, reproducible experiment; the crazy claim built on top of it is what the fresh session gets to judge
